packageRules.description: Cap TypeScript below 7 until typescript-eslint supports the TS 7 compiler API. TS 7.0 ships no public programmatic API, and typescript-eslint@8 (pulled in as a hard dependency of @antfu/eslint-config) declares peer `typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0`. Type-aware linting via @typescript-eslint/project-service is active in packages/config, so TS 7 breaks `pnpm lint` in every workspace package. tsc, tsdown and vitest are all already TS 7-ready — ESLint is the sole blocker. Support is expected in TS 7.1 (~Autumn 2026); remove this cap then.

Label runtime-dependency upgrades so the renovate-changeset CI workflow adds a real patch changeset that triggers a release (devDependency-only bumps intentionally get none). Hosted Renovate (Mend) disables postUpgradeTasks and ignores allowedPostUpgradeCommands in repo config, so changeset generation lives in .github/workflows/renovate-changeset.yml instead. (STRUCT-075 / CR-006)
